ideas.pitch: An AI-powered academic copilot connecting institution management systems and document repositories using Model Context Protocol and RAG for automated workflow management.
ideas.title: EduFlow MCP Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the hackathon's core objective of eliminating administrative inefficiencies and integrating workflows rather than building isolated features, heavily mirroring past winning architectural patterns.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered clinical examination training platform for university medical and nursing departments, featuring real-time rubric scoring and interactive simulated patient interviews.
ideas.title: CampusClinic AI OSCE
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-impact domain-specific simulation pattern that won major hackathons by offering a production-ready vertical tool for higher education.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent document transformation engine that turns static university syllabi, lecture notes, and administrative PDFs into interactive semantic knowledge graphs and AI study assistants.
ideas.title: Syllabus2Knowledge Base
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the fragmented communication and manual resource management problems faced by educational organizations by converting raw institutional files into structured digital utilities.

ideas.pitch: A smart university app that matches students for peer-to-peer exam prep and collaborative study groups while automatically maintaining and organizing their verified academic portfolios.
ideas.title: PeerStudy & Portfolio Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses student-facing collaboration and administrative bottlenecks in colleges, following a proven winning blueprint from university-focused hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student support platform tailored for campus sustainability initiatives, tracking green metrics and providing personalized guidance for institutional eco-programs.
ideas.title: EduGreen Agentic Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines multi-agent system architecture with real-world institutional impact, aligning with judges' preference for scalable, production-ready software solutions.
